item.tib: o rgyan yul gyi mjal snang
item.coloph: de ltar kho bo'i rmi lam 'khrul snang 'di/ gong mas bka' yi zhal ngad gnang nas su/ dkar chag yi ge ris su btab pa 'di/ 'gal bar gyur na bla ma rje la bshags/ ma sring byams pa'i tshogs la bzod par gsol/ bka' srung rnams kyi 'phrag dogs mi mdzad zhu/ 'di bzhengs dge ba dri med mthu ldan gyis/ 'gro rnams o rgyan yul du skye bar shog/
